import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.sensor as sens
import numpy as np

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChronoDataPath("/path/to/chrono/data/")

mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "models/teddy.obj")

body_mesh = chrono.ChVisualShapeMesh(mesh)

body.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
sys.Add(body)

# Create a sensor manager

# Create a lidar sensor

    body, 
    10, 
    chrono.ChFrameD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 2), chrono.Q_from_AngAxis(0, chrono.ChVectorD(1, 0, 0))),
    900, 
    225, 
    chrono.ChVectorf(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
